description: Authoritative data-licence gate for the MedRadar public repository. Consumed by the integration pipeline and CI. A source with may_redistribute=false must NOT have its payload committed: the export gate (tools/convergence/licence/licence_gate.py) enforces this.

rights_model.may_query: Automated requests to the published endpoint are permitted.
rights_model.may_ingest: Fetched material may be persisted locally.
rights_model.may_analyse_locally: Derived analysis over ingested material is permitted.
rights_model.may_redistribute: Materialised/derived records may be committed to this public repository.

status_definitions.public_domain: US federal government work or an explicit public-domain/CC0 dedication: no reuse restriction is asserted.
status_definitions.open_licence: A named open licence (OGL, CC-BY, CC0) grants redistribution provided attribution is given.
status_definitions.open_no_explicit_licence: Published openly with no reuse licence asserted. Query and local analysis are safe; redistribution is unverified. Records may be published only with attribution and an explicit rights caveat.
status_definitions.terms_restricted: Publisher terms prohibit or condition automated retrieval and/or redistribution. Requires written permission.
status_definitions.requires_licence: Access is contractual (subscription/EULA). No open right to query, store or redistribute.
status_definitions.unknown: No licence text could be read, or the host is technically unreachable. Silence is not permission.

gate_contract.declared_files: files[].path is relative to the export directory
gate_contract.allow: declared file whose source has may_redistribute=true and is present
gate_contract.quarantine: declared file whose source has may_redistribute=false and is absent
gate_contract.violation: declared file whose source has may_redistribute=false but is present
gate_contract.missing_expected: declared file whose source has may_redistribute=true but is absent
gate_contract.unknown_source: declared file whose source_id is not in this policy

un_comtrade.name: UN Comtrade — International Trade Statistics (public preview API)
un_comtrade.status_rationale: Publisher terms prohibit or condition automated retrieval and/or redistribution. Requires written permission.
un_comtrade.notes: Usage Agreement §5 forbids 'any copying, automated browsing or downloading, redistribution, publication, or commercial exploitation' without prior written permission from the Director, UNSD. The public preview API is nevertheless documented for programmatic use ('call it from your program', no key, <=500 rows), so the two instruments conflict. Audited position: query + bounded local analysis defensible under the API invitation; redistribution NOT defensible. Either obtain written permission or drop the source. Quarantine is enforced by the export gate.
un_comtrade.attribution_text: United Nations Comtrade Database, United Nations Statistics Division (used under the public preview API; redistribution not permitted).
un_comtrade.ingest_conditions: public preview endpoint only; one reference period per request; <=1 request/second; no bulk endpoint; no keyed /data/v1 path.
